--src: Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Field.Basic
protected theorem List.nnnorm_prod (l : List α) : ‖l.prod‖₊ = (l.map nnnorm).prod :=
  map_list_prod (nnnormHom.toMonoidHom : α →* ℝ≥0) _

--src: Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.CliffordAlgebra.Conjugation
/-- Taking the involute of the product a list of $n$ vectors lifted via `ι` is equivalent to
premultiplying by ${-1}^n$. -/
theorem involute_prod_map_ι :
    ∀ l : List M, involute (l.map <| ι Q).prod = (-1 : R) ^ l.length • (l.map <| ι Q).prod
  | [] => by simp
  | x::xs => by simp [pow_succ, involute_prod_map_ι xs]

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Defs
theorem compHom_smul_def (s : S) (x : A) :
    letI := compHom A f
    s • x = f s • x := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.List
/-- This is the `List.prod` version of `mul_inv` -/
@[to_additive "This is the `List.sum` version of `add_neg`"]
theorem prod_inv : ∀ L : List G, L.prod⁻¹ = (L.map fun x => x⁻¹).prod
  | [] => by simp
  | x :: xs => by simp [mul_comm, prod_inv xs]

--src: Mathlib.RingTheory.Regular.RegularSequence
lemma ofList_cons_smul {R} [CommSemiring R] (r : R) (rs : List R) {M}
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (N : Submodule R M) :
    ofList (r :: rs) • N = r • N ⊔ ofList rs • N := by
  rw [ofList_cons, Submodule.sup_smul, Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]

--src: Mathlib.Data.NNReal.Defs
@[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_nsmul (r : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) : ↑(n • r) = n • (r : ℝ) := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.CharP.Two
theorem list_sum_sq (l : List R) : l.sum ^ 2 = (l.map (· ^ 2)).sum :=
  list_sum_pow_char _ _

--src: Mathlib.RingTheory.Regular.RegularSequence
@[simp] lemma map_ofList (f : R →+* S) (rs : List R) :
    map f (ofList rs) = ofList (rs.map f) :=
  Eq.trans (map_span f { r | r ∈ rs }) <| congrArg span <|
    Set.ext (fun _ => List.mem_map.symm)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Holor
theorem mul_scalar_mul [Monoid α] (x : Holor α []) (y : Holor α ds) :
    x ⊗ y = x ⟨[], Forall₂.nil⟩ • y := by
  simp (config := { unfoldPartialApp := true }) [mul, SMul.smul, HolorIndex.take, HolorIndex.drop,
    HSMul.hSMul]
-- holor slices

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.FreeMonoid.Basic
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem ofList_cons (x : α) (xs : List α) : ofList (x :: xs) = of x * ofList xs := rfl
